import ctypes
import os

def generate_permutations():
    # Load the libraries in the correct order
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

    # Define GSL constants and functions
    GSL_SUCCESS = 0

    gsl_permutation_alloc = gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc
    gsl_permutation_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_permutation_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)

    gsl_permutation_init = gsl.gsl_permutation_init
    gsl_permutation_init.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
    gsl_permutation_init.restype = None

    gsl_permutation_next = gsl.gsl_permutation_next
    gsl_permutation_next.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
    gsl_permutation_next.restype = ctypes.c_int

    gsl_permutation_free = gsl.gsl_permutation_free
    gsl_permutation_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
    gsl_permutation_free.restype = None

    gsl_permutation_get = gsl.gsl_permutation_get
    gsl_permutation_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_permutation_get.restype = ctypes.c_uint

    # Allocate and initialize the permutation object
    n = 3
    p = gsl_permutation_alloc(n)
    gsl_permutation_init(p)

    # Generate permutations
    permutations = []
    while True:
        current_permutation = [gsl_permutation_get(p, i) for i in range(n)]
        permutations.append(current_permutation)

        if gsl_permutation_next(p) != GSL_SUCCESS:
            break

    # Free the permutation object
    gsl_permutation_free(p)

    return permutations

    # Test case 1: Verify the generated permutations for n=3
    expected_permutations = [
        [0, 1, 2],
        [0, 2, 1],
        [1, 0, 2],
        [1, 2, 0],
        [2, 0, 1],
        [2, 1, 0]
    ]
    assert generate_permutations() == expected_permutations, "Test case 1 failed: Permutations do not match expected output."

    # Test case 2: Verify the function handles library loading correctly
    try:
        ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
        ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    except OSError as e:
        assert False, f"Test case 2 failed: Library loading error - {e}"

    print("All test cases passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
